items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: He is a young black man who heard Scott Joplin recordings.

ctx.x: He is a young black man who heard Scott Joplin recordings. He was 13 years old. Reginald was 13 years old, a Chicago guy. He taught himself how to do fingering to play ragtime and he’s really a genius. He taught himself how to play, Bob Koester from Delmark Records heard about him and took him under his wing. Reginald went to — I’m not sure what the music school was — and the teacher there said he does the fingering right, which was astonishing.
